feedback: Approved. The candidate is the iteration 8 design, unchanged, which is the best raced design (430.6 in iteration 8). Its controller (base_speed 1.1, kp 2.5, kd 0.8, ki 0.02, weights [-1.5 to 1.5], last_direction) and seven-sensor geometry (x = -0.075 to 0.075 m, y 0.06, size 0.012) match the iteration 8 record. Iteration 8 gave 20 of 20 oval finishes at 1.87 s and one s-bend finish, with s-bend progress up from 0.22 to 0.59 versus the five-sensor design. Iterations 9 and 10 both scored lower, so there is no measured reason to change it. Its slalom still ends off track at about 0.063 m max_error, so the candidate does not solve slalom, but no tested variant has done better. There is no further iteration to use a revision, so a re-review would cost action runs with no return. Approve so the design races. The off-track limit is 0.06 m, as the rationale states. Any result from this race should be read per track against the iteration 8 numbers.
requested_changes: No change for this final race: keep kp 2.5, kd 0.8, base_speed 1.1 and the seven-sensor span, since iteration 8 is the best measured design.
Record per-track completion, progress, max_error, line_loss_events and steering_oscillation for the oval, s-bend and slalom, so the next team can see which lever was limiting.
Untested levers for any future work: outer sensor_weights about 1.2 to cut s-bend steering_oscillation (0.34 in iteration 8), and line_loss set to search_right to test slalom line loss.
